summary: Regional hub shipment held for missing battery paperwork; temporary courier badge & PoE desk setup required for satellite office go-live
description: A bulk shipment bound for Redwood's new satellite workspace in Portland (sat-site-OR1) is being held at the regional courier hub due to missing lithium battery declarations on three pallet manifests. The shipment contains 12 monitors (with integrated batteries for local dimmer), 6 PoE kiosks, and 8 docking stations. The on-site contractor team is scheduled to do final desk assembly on 2026-03-13 and needs temporary escorted badge access and a configured PoE switch VLAN to power the kiosks. This ticket coordinates courier release, temporary badge issuance, and network/AV prep so the go-live isn't delayed.
impact: Potential 1 business-day delay to satellite office onboarding affecting 9 contractors and 4 engineers. Standups and demos scheduled on 2026-03-14 could be impacted if monitors and PoE kiosks are not available.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Confirm manifest received from logistics partner (tracking numbers in investigation_notes).
2) Courier flagged hazardous materials exception for incomplete battery declaration on 3 pallets.
3) Attempted remote release via courier portal failed due to missing shipper declaration PDF.
4) Facilities attempted to produce proof of safe packaging but courier requires signed commercial invoice with battery details.
5) Contractor on-site attempted to access building lobby; temporary badge not yet provisioned and front desk will not accept unsigned courier release.
investigation_notes: Courier hold first observed 2026-03-09 18:24 PDT (FedEx hold code: HZ-MANIFEST).
Tracking IDs: 789FEXUS12345, 789FEXUS12346, 789FEXUS12347 (three pallets with integrated battery components).
Carrier correspondence: courier-support@fedex.com thread started 2026-03-09 referencing missing 'Lithium Ion Battery Documentation' attachment.

Facilities found packing list from vendor but missing battery declaration page; vendor (BlueBox Logistics) emailed corrected PDF at 2026-03-10 09:12 PDT but courier portal requires original shipper-signed commercial invoice (not a forwarded PDF).
Security notes: temporary badge requests must go through SSO approval; contractor identity has already been vetted in Okta but 'temporary-site-access' group not yet created for sat-site-OR1.

Network notes: PoE switch at sat-site-OR1 needs VLAN 314 provisioned for kiosks; switch is on the edge PoE-CORE-OR1 with firmware 2.8.1. A previous VLAN template was applied for desks but did not include 802.3at power policy.
comments: 2026-03-10 10:03 - Diego Morales: Reached out to BlueBox to request a shipper-signed commercial invoice. Asked vendor to send courier portal upload directly and CC facilities. Assigning Security to temporary badge path.

2026-03-10 11:20 - Samir Gupta (Security): Okta has the contractor entries, but we need an explicit temporary-site-access group and an escorted badge window for 2026-03-13 08:00-11:00. Creating group and workflow now.

2026-03-10 13:42 - Riley Chen (Network): PoE-CORE-OR1 currently lacks 802.3at policy; will schedule a config push for VLAN 314 during maintenance window 2026-03-12 02:30-03:00 to minimize disruption. Confirming power budget for 6 kiosks.

2026-03-11 09:07 - Diego Morales: FedEx replied — they will release pallets if shipper-authorized commercial invoice uploaded by 2026-03-11 EOD. BlueBox has uploaded but portal flagged mismatch (signature hash). I will coordinate an escorted pick-up as fallback.

2026-03-12 15:55 - Asha Patel: Front desk confirmed escorted pick-up plan on 2026-03-13 08:15. Security to provide two temporary escorted emergency badges valid for the single-day window. Network config push completed at 02:37; PoE now delivers expected power levels in test VLAN.
planned_resolution: 1) Facilities to coordinate with vendor and carrier to ensure shipper-signed commercial invoice is uploaded; if carrier portal rejects, schedule courier escorted release. 2) Security to issue two time-bound escorted badges for 2026-03-13 08:00-12:00 and notify front desk. 3) Network to confirm PoE provisioning for VLAN 314 and mark switch as ready. 4) On-site contractor to confirm receipt and sign asset acceptance. 5) Post-delivery update ticket with asset tags and final photos.
notes_for_postmortem: Consider adding a mandatory pre-ship checklist for battery declarations for all vendor shipments containing AV equipment.
Create a reusable Okta group template for 'temporary-site-access' per site to reduce manual provisioning steps.
Validate courier portal signature/hash acceptance with major carriers to avoid time-consuming re-uploads.
